entries.title: Add a computer by its address first
entries.body: In Settings → Devices, + A computer now opens straight to the address form, since a computer added by its address is kept updated and reached from here by itself; the link and the command sit under it, each saying when to use it. A Windows PC keeps the link and the command. A new Mac, or an x64 Linux computer, now leads its first launch with Set up from your first mate's computer: its address to type there, private network address first, whether Remote Login is on, and it follows along once added.

picture.alt: Settings, Devices, with + A computer's address form open, the computers nearby under it, and the link and the command below as the other ways
